description: Generate a Seedance 2.5 video using a primary image, up to 30 reference images, or a reference video.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Video generation prompt describing motion, subject consistency, camera movement, and the ecommerce scene. Maximum 2000 characters.
fields.example: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.

fields.name: promptOptimizer
fields.description: Whether Nexscope should optimize the video prompt before generation. Defaults to false.

fields.name: isPro
fields.description: Whether to use the model's professional generation mode when supported. Defaults to false.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of a first-frame or primary reference image. Each image must be between 300 and 6000 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: imageList
fields.description: Public reference image URLs. Provide 1 to 30 images. Each image must be between 300 and 6000 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: video
fields.description: Optional public reference-video URL list. Reference-video mode cannot be combined with image references or a final-frame image.

fields.name: aspectRatio
fields.description: Target video aspect ratio supported by this model. Supported values: 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16, 21:9.

example.prompt: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.
